open-question.question: How large is the cache?
open-question.recommendation: A <small> cap keeps a scan & a warmup short.
open-question.alternative: Cap the cache at 100 entries. A scan stays short. More reads miss. Warmup is quick. Entries past the cap are evicted.
Let the cache grow <unbounded> & unchecked. No read misses for size.
